description: Hand-painted flowers, birds and pots by Calico Melton, a painter in Bristol. Giclée prints of her paintings, to buy online.
heroLine: Bright, hand-painted flowers, birds and pots, made in my studio in Bristol and printed on beautiful paper.
introText:
I paint in a small studio in Bristol: flowers, birds, and the pots and vases they live in.

My prints are scanned straight from the original paintings, with no digital retouching, then printed on beautiful 300gsm prestige paper.
